name: @aether/service-ops-center
displayName: Ops Center (Chaos Drills, Runbooks-as-Data, FinOps Attribution)
description: Operational readiness as a product: chaos game-day drills are pack scenarios (fault injections + expected invariants + rollback verification), runbooks are GENERATED from the live product registry (every product gets one — zero drift), and FinOps attributes metered usage to per-tenant unit economics with pack-defined resource costs. Doctrine recursion: operations derive from products and packs, never from tribal knowledge.
